Show the time of another zone where the seconds normally are, with a three-letter name. A + or - after the name means it is already tomorrow or still yesterday there. After a battery change it comes back as soon as the phone connects.

Restart the watch?
It restarts and reconnects in a few seconds.
Erase the watch\'s pairings?
The watch erases all pairings and restarts. Then remove it in Gadgetbridge and forget it in Android\'s Bluetooth settings, and pair it again.
